verdict.rationale: The evidence includes the product's own public GitHub repository (github.com/crossplane/crossplane), and the docs reference master and release branches, so the source appears readable. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., an OSI-approved license), documentation of governance or openness, and independent corroboration.
